title: Fiscal policy costings
description: Original Treasury scorecard costings, positive means revenue gained.
notes: Copied from the OBR policy measures database, £m / 1000. Years the OBR extrapolated with nominal GDP are excluded. A costing is linked to a rate change only when exactly one measure matches its event, first year and sign. Whether a costing includes behaviour is not stated, so it is blank, not guessed.
